explication: BRAKER is a command-line genome-annotation pipeline: users provide a genome and RNA-seq and/or protein evidence, and receive predicted gene annotations. The README describes automated training and prediction with GeneMark and AUGUSTUS, with extrinsic evidence informing predictions; it also describes BRAKER3's highly supported combined gene set. The graph includes these documented stages and substantial indexed scripts. Source excerpts do not show how the main Perl pipeline dispatches helpers, so those connections are omitted.
